newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street shares seen mixed to higher.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street shares seen mixed to higher.

text.p: U.S. stocks are expected to open mixed to higher on Monday, as tentative investors seek bargains after Wall Street's sharp tumble on Friday while remaining mindful of a batch of economic data due this week.

Stocks sank on Friday, spooked by rising bond yields that pointed to higher interest rates. Analysts said they could recoup some losses on Monday, but trading would probably be volatile and choppy until the release on inflation and retail sales data due later in the week.
